bio: Vanjee is a New York-based DJ and producer with over two decades on the scene, drawing intimate crowds with house sets at spots like 1 OAK NYC and Lio Ibiza and playing marathon tech-house sets at Club Space, Timewarp, El Row and Music On. He moved to New York at 21 to build his international DJ career, quickly landing residencies at Pacha NY, Club Space and Cipriani, and is now part of the Black Coffee Saturdays season at Hi Ibiza and the BPM Festival circuit.
labels: Get Physical, Stereo Productions, Saved Records, Defected Records, Be Crazy Music; founded his own label Global Vibration in 2007
notable_collaborations: Erick Morillo and Little Louie Vega (remixes released via Global Vibration)
burning_man_history: Artist profile bios cite performing at Burning Man in the Nevada desert as one of his recurring festival appearances, alongside BPM Festival and Hi Ibiza's Black Coffee Saturdays.

bio: DJ Zip Disk (Ted Alsop) is a Wisconsin house and techno DJ active in the Milwaukee/Madison scene, playing minimal, deep house, tech house and acid sets, including at Cactus Club Milwaukee's Club Ritual series.

L'CORE is a Las Vegas-based dance/pop artist releasing a steady run of singles on Apple Music through 2025-2026, most recently "Let Me Tell Ya Something" (Aug 2026), and appearing as a featured artist on Danny D's single "BOSSY."
notable_releases: King of My Castle (2026), I Still Believe (2026), Full Disclosure (2025), Afro Love (2025), Confessions (2025), Let Me Tell Ya Something (2026 single)

bio: Grant Kaye is a Truckee, California-based photographer, cinematographer/timelapse artist and DJ with roots in Lāna'i, Hawai'i, spinning deep house, funky tech house, funky techno and breaks. Separately from his photography career (which includes nonprofit fundraiser work), he has been involved in Burning Man's art world for years.
burning_man_history: Bio states he has been instrumental in a number of Burning Man art projects, including Electric Lady Land, The Ship, Embrace, and the Space Whales.

bio: illich Mujica is a Venezuelan-born, New York City-bred DJ, producer and musical curator known for uplifting melodic house blended with dark, mysterious beats, describing his sets as a collaborative energy exchange with the dancefloor.
burning_man_history: Released a live DJ set recorded atop the Disco Space Shuttle art car at Burning Man 2022 (Thursday night, described as "an incredible cosmic ride into Deep Playa"); also has a documented Love Cow set from Burning Man 2017 Sunday sunrise.

bio: Natascha Polké is a Swiss producer, singer and DJ from Zurich whose sound spans melodic house, deep house and electronica. Coming from an indie/folk-pop background, she cut her teeth in Zurich's techno underground before relocating to London, where she held a residency at the Roundhouse.
notable_releases: Stars Wrapped in Skin EP (2021, debut), Hide Away / Another Round (2021, This Never Happened), Echoes with Fejká (2025, Anjunadeep), Into You EP (2026, [PIAS] Électronique)
labels: Definition:Music, This Never Happened, Anjunadeep, [PIAS] Électronique
notable_collaborations: Oliver Koletzki ("Mind Games," Stil vor Talent), Fejká ("Echoes," Anjunadeep)

bio: Deniz Reno (born Deniz Rakhmanova) is a Toronto-based Canadian singer-songwriter, DJ, producer and multi-instrumentalist originally from Almaty, Kazakhstan. She blends velvety pop/soul vocals with Eastern vocal riffs into high-energy hybrid DJ sets, and gained wider recognition in 2013 for a cover of "Wicked Game" with producer Anton Ishutin that drew millions of views. She is a member of the Recording Academy (Grammys).
notable_releases: "Give Me More" (Taksu Records); "Wicked Game" cover with Anton Ishutin (2013)
labels: Armada, Glasgow Underground, Mau5trap, Warner; founder of Taksu Records (founded summer 2018, named for a Balinese concept)
burning_man_history: Bio states she has performed at Burning Man and ADE, alongside venues including Hard Rock Ibiza, The Chocolate Factory (NYC), Club Joker (Morocco), CODA, Vertigo and Soluna Toronto.

bio: Xinobi (born 1978) is a producer who emerged from the mid-2000s music-blog scene and a background in punk rock and amateur skateboarding before turning to house music; his catalog traces that passage from DIY/punk culture into dance music. He co-founded the label and collective Discotexas/DTX with fellow producer Moullinex.
notable_releases: On The Quiet (album), including "Far Away Place" and "Searching For" (a collaboration with Lazarusman); "Fado Para Esta Noite" with fado singer Gisela João (2019)
labels: Discotexas/DTX (co-founder), Anjunadeep, Cercle, Moblack, Monaberry, Frau Blau, Deutsche Grammophon, TAU, Watergate
notable_collaborations: Moullinex (label co-founder), Lazarusman ("Searching For"), Gisela João ("Fado Para Esta Noite," 2019)

bio: Mobâd is a producer working in progressive and tropical house, with tracks including "Ask About Me" and "We Hate That $hit" available on Apple Music, Shazam and SoundCloud.
notable_releases: Ask About Me; We Hate That $hit

bio: Louis The Child is a Chicago-area duo, Robby Hauldren and Freddy Kennett, who met at a Madeon concert in 2012 while students at New Trier High School in Winnetka, IL. They debuted with the Dimensions EP (2013), then broke out with "It's Strange" (2015), which Taylor Swift added to her "Songs that Will Make Life Awesome" playlist and which was featured on the FIFA 16 soundtrack.
notable_releases: Dimensions EP (2013), "It's Strange" (2015), Here for Now (2020, debut album), Love Is Alive

bio: OVEOUS is a poet, singer and producer whose live sets have played festivals as far afield as Dubai and TV spots including HBO, late night TV, and Showtime at the Apollo. In 2018 he teamed with longtime collaborator QVLN on "Queimar," named a top track of the year by Traxsource.
labels: Yoruba Records, Atjazz Record Company, Offering Recordings, Vega Records, Moca Arts
notable_collaborations: QVLN, Roy Ayers, Louie Vega, Osunlade, Ursula Rucker

bio: ọba+flip is a DJ duo based in Brooklyn, New York, who met at an underground techno party in 2017 and have been playing together since 2020. The name blends "ọba" (Yoruba for "king," the first language of ọba's mother) with "flip," a nod to the flip phone she still carried when they met. Their sets merge house, techno and other styles with an emphasis on space and groove.
burning_man_history: Opened DISTRIKT's 2023 Burning Man season at the camp's home at 10 & K; documented in an Apple Podcasts episode titled "ọba+flip - DISTRIKT - Burning Man 2023."

bio: Truprwulf is a bass house and future bass producer/DJ active on SoundCloud, known for annually-updated "Atlantis" mixes blending bass house and future styles; in his own words, "When I go harder or late night, I tend to go bass house and future."
notable_releases: Atlantis 2025 Future Bass House Mix, Atlantis 2026 Bass House Dance Mix

bio: 2JUICY is a dubstep and bass producer/DJ ("Dubstep and Bass for the feels") who has opened for Soohan, Mr. Carmack and Lil Fish.
FIENDI (pronounced "feen-dee") is a dubstep and bass producer/DJ with music on SoundCloud and Apple Music, tagged on the event site of Arizona promoter Relentless Beats.
